caption: A drone hovering over a field loses power, and it drops straight down into the grass.

sa.check: A drone hovers over a field.
It loses power and its rotors stop.
It drops straight down into the grass.
The rotors stop first and the drop follows.

pc.expect: It falls the moment the rotors stop and not before.
pc.fail: It falls with the rotors spinning; or stays up with the rotors still; or rises.

pc.expect: It accelerates downward and lands below where it hovered.
pc.fail: It glides away; or slows before landing; or hovers.

pc.expect: It goes straight down with no gliding.
pc.fail: It goes sideways; or curves; or spins away.

pc.expect: It is rigid and may break on landing.
pc.fail: It bounces high; or melts; or floats.
It duplicates; or vanishes in the air; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The drone and the field stay the same.
pc.fail: The drone changes colour; or the field rearranges; or the sky changes.
